content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"review","note":"The record links cited ROI evidence to the Agency's findings (e.g., tasks 'routine duties' and 'reasonable' deadlines leading to no prima facie reprisal case), but the underlying ROI exhibits are only summarized, the appellate conclusion is removed, and some steps are unconnected, such as the FAD's 'used only once' finding alongside the IPO's repeated use of the term in the January 31 and February 25 meetings."},"rc2":{"status":"pass","note":"Nearly every characterization is attributed to a named role (Complainant, IPO, HR-1, Subordinate-1) with ROI or FAD pin cites, though a few Agency assertions, such as the mediation changes and the Complainant's complaint to HR-2, lack a visible source."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Most events are dated and sequenced (Jan 31, Feb 24-25, Mar 2020, May 13-15, May 31, Jun 15, 2020; Apr 19 and Jun 3, 2021), but the HR-1 phone call is undated, the mediation timing is absent, the 'March 5, 2020' reference is unexplained, and the investigation period and the date of the appeal are not stated."},"rc4":{"status":"review","note":"The Agency's criteria are named (prima facie reprisal, severe or pervasive, reasonable person, imputed liability), but no individual FAD decision-maker is identified, and the record does not show whether the omissions raised in Complainant's April 19, 2021 letter and the April 22-27 emails were considered before the decision was finalized."},"rc5":{"status":"review","note":"The record is a secondary summary of the ROI and FAD with outcome text removed, so an independent reviewer would need the underlying ROI exhibits, the FAD, the mediation record, and the omitted witness information to test the conclusion."}},"remediation_note":"Attach or index the underlying ROI exhibits and the full FAD, identify the FAD decision-maker, and document how the omissions raised in the April 19, 2021 letter (Subordinate-2, Subordinate-3, HR-2) were disposed of before the decision was finalized. Add the missing dates (HR-1 call, mediation, investigation period, appeal filing) and a source for the mediation outcomes."}
